Model: nace-ai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Kapitsa
Organisation: nace-ai
Source tags: source:hf-model, license:apache-2.0, context:commercial-safe, family:qwen, org:nace-ai
Model card: Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 for Kapitsa The draft model that Kapitsa uses to speed up Qwen3.8 27B on a Mac. It starts from incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 and makes the 27B decode about 6-9% faster on an M5 Pro. Replies are the same as without a drafter, except where the 27B's top two tokens are essentially tied. Speed M5 Pro 48 GB, Qwen3.8 27B 4-bit, 36 prompts (chat, code, math), greedy, 512 tokens, 3 interleaved rounds. | Drafter | Tokens per check | Decode (tok/s) | | --- | ---: | ---: | | incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 | 5.04 | 71.7 | | this drafter | 5.36 | 78.1 | 78.1 is the mean of the two rounds where both drafters ran warm. Counting the first round, where this drafter ran cold, the mean is 75.8 tok/s. What changed from incoai's drafter Same architecture and tensors. The config's is 16 (it was 8), because Kapitsa drafts 16 tokens at a time for one conversation. We fine-tuned it for one epoch on 18,000 replies that Qwen3.8 27B (4-bit) wrote at temperature 0, with the DFlash2 training objective at block 16. Revisions - : this drafter. - : incoai's drafter unchanged (015e795), kept here for rollback. License Apache-2.0, as the incoai drafter it is derived from.
